3Dmol.js is bundled for offline molecular visualization.

Source: https://3dmol.org/build/3Dmol-min.js
License source: https://github.com/3dmol/3Dmol.js/blob/master/LICENSE
Downloaded: 2026-11-03
License: MIT/BSD components; see 3Dmol-LICENSE.txt and notices in the script.
Documentation: https://3dmol.org/doc/

The application serves this exact local file. It does not load the viewer
from a CDN at runtime. No external molecule downloads are invoked by the
viewer wrapper. Prepared structure and pose data come from the project.
